title: Son of Scoregasm
description:
Son of ScoregasmBlast your way through 28 varied levels full of enemies, traps, lasers and bosses in this explosive Twin Stick Shmup! Test your skills, find new paths, master the score mechanics and become bullet hell. Tight score attack play, fast combat and online Leaderboards leave you needing just one more go!

Fight past hordes of enemies, unlock new routes on the map and defeat seven fearsome robot bosses to save the galaxy! Practice any stage in Score-Attack mode to perfect your skills, conquer the leaderboards and unlock all the score medallions! 

Features• Fun and frantic twin stick action!

• 28 varied levels

• 7 different endings

• Expert difficulty for expert players

• Full Controller support

• Steam Leaderboards

• Biscuits!
